theme: Exact-query response and transport fail-closed acceptance
facts: Exact query must identify the intended borough target layer.
Exact query must bind the canonical candidate row and coordinates.
Positive evidence must include actual returned feature identity or complete polygon intersection.
Negative evidence must come from an actual authoritative no-hit response or complete-geometry exclusion.
HTTP/cache/safe-URL failure is not an empty feature response.
DNS failure is not a negative spatial result.
Binary download failure is not proof of no intersection.
Service-root success is not child-layer query success.
Layer name alone is not candidate membership.
Service-wide extent overlap is not layer membership.
BBox overlap is not polygon intersection.
Complete authoritative bbox exclusion can support a negative only when completeness and target semantics are established.
Every production response requires UTC access time and body SHA-256 under the canonical 330-job contract.
Dependent object-ID, ordered-window and pagination-chain outputs must preserve subrequest lineage.
No score is written until response acceptance and binding gates pass.
execution_observation: Direct child-layer opens remained blocked by web safe-URL/cache handling during this continuation; no membership response was invented.
